fixes: Send explicit reasoning effort through supported thread config.model_reasoning_effort as well as turn/start.effort.
Preserve server-returned reasoning effort; verify changed effort rather than recording a requested value as confirmed.
Recognize a loaded thread's previously verified policy from thread/resume, apply authorized changes through turn/start, then verify the effective policy. Stop on genuine mismatches.
Expose executable metadata to development diagnostics without adding chat UI.
confirmationLimits: turn/start acknowledges a turn ID and status; it does not echo model, effort or policy. The report keeps these fields absent in that acknowledgment.
Configuration confirmation comes from thread/start or thread/resume. Changed loaded-thread configuration is read back after turn/start.

The initial unconditional immediate readback experiment failed with server error list_turns is not supported yet on a new thread; it was replaced with conditional readback and the affected live tests passed.

diagnostics.providerHarnessConversationId: Correlation ID only; actual Athena conversation IDs are in the UI evidence.

validation.installedRequestSchemas: Exact match for ThreadStartParams, TurnStartParams, SandboxPolicy and AskForApproval

limitations: Live tests used disposable temporary directories, not Metrobank repositories or services.

Native sub-agent rendering, file-diff rendering, failed-turn handling and dropped-stream recovery have fixture coverage; live sub-agent/diff/failure and forced network-disconnection scenarios were not verified in this audit.
Windows was not physically tested. Organization-enforced policy denials were fixture tested, not induced on the user's account.
No separate premium API route or billing fallback was used; this verifies the selected ChatGPT subscription path, not external billing-account balances.
